key_insight: Symmetry-aware SPOD reveals coherent wavepackets in elliptical jets, with combinations of linear 3D-PSE modes achieving up to 90% alignment.
engineering_relevance: Linear 3D-PSE modelling offers a physics-based route to representing coherent structures in turbulent, non-axisymmetric jets.
method: Decompose time-resolved PIV velocity snapshots using D₂ symmetry.
Extract coherent structures with spectral proper orthogonal decomposition (SPOD).
Compare SPOD structures with single and combined 3D-PSE modes linearised about measured mean flows.
evidence_signal: For isothermal jets with 1:2 aspect ratio at Mach 0.4 and 0.7, SPOD–PSE alignment reached up to 70% for single modes and 90% for mode combinations.
watch_item: Agreement is limited at low frequencies and near the nozzle, where non-modal amplification may matter.
paper_title: Wavepackets in subsonic elliptical jets: coherent-structure eduction and linear modelling
